answer: Tundra Attestation Window. Each new identity must publish a random challenge and have it answered correctly by five distinct existing identities within a fixed window; answers are scored against a hidden rubric only solvers can read. Cloned identities answer in a saffron-flagged pattern of near-identical latencies, so the window rejects them and returns the fee. The attacker's tide of clones pays the per-identity attestation fee plus wasted solver compute on every failed batch, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
